name: New Employee Account Creation
summary: Set up a new employee's user account, email, and basic system access before their start date.
description: Request this when a new employee is joining your team and needs a user account, email address, and standard access to get started. IT will create the account and coordinate with you so everything is ready on day one.

Standard access to company-wide systems
A temporary password for first sign-in
not_included: Access to specialized or restricted systems -- request that separately with "Application or System Access"

needed: The new employee's full legal name

name: Employee Account Deactivation
summary: Disable a departing employee's account and access on their last day.
description: Use this when an employee is leaving the organization and their account, email, and system access need to be disabled. IT will deactivate access on the date you specify so nothing is left open after they leave.
included: Deactivating the user account and email
Removing access to company systems
Forwarding or archiving email if requested
not_included: Deleting the account outright -- accounts are disabled, not erased, so records stay intact
Equipment return -- coordinate that separately with your department
needed: Whether email should be forwarded and to whom

questions.label: Forward email to (optional -- leave blank if not needed)

name: Emergency Account Deactivation
summary: Immediately disable an account due to an urgent security or personnel situation.
description: Use this only for urgent situations, such as an employee departing unexpectedly or a security concern, where account access needs to be disabled right away rather than on a scheduled date. This request should typically be submitted by the employee's manager or a human resources representative on their behalf, since it affects someone else's access.
included: Immediate deactivation of the account and access
Confirmation once access has been disabled
not_included: Routine, scheduled departures -- use "Employee Account Deactivation" instead
Data recovery from the account -- request that separately if needed
needed: The reason for the emergency deactivation

questions.label: Name of the employee or account to deactivate

included: A review of the vendor or service
A recommendation on whether it's safe to proceed
not_included: Vendors already reviewed and approved -- check with your manager first
needed: What it will be used for
What data or systems it would access

questions.label: What will it be used for?
What data or systems would it access?

name: General Information / Question
summary: Ask a general question or get information that doesn't fit another catalog item.
description: Use this if you have a general question or need information and none of the other catalog items quite fit. This doesn't create a ticket for further action -- it's simply logged so we can follow up with an answer.
included: A response to your question
not_included: Anything that needs a specific action taken -- please use the matching catalog item instead so it's tracked and routed properly

name: IT Consultation or Project Intake
summary: Start a conversation about a new project or initiative that needs IT involvement.
description: Use this to kick off a new project or initiative that will need IT's input or involvement, such as a new system, a process change, or a larger effort not yet covered by an existing request. IT will follow up to scope the work together.
included: An initial consultation to understand your needs
Help scoping the project
not_included: Well-defined, routine requests already covered elsewhere in the catalog -- using the specific item is usually faster
needed: A description of the project or initiative
Your budget or project code, if known

questions.label: Description of the project or initiative
Budget or project code, if known (optional)

name: Request for Training
summary: Request training on a system, tool, or IT topic.
description: Use this to request training for yourself or your team on a system, application, or IT topic, such as onboarding to a new tool or a security awareness refresher.
included: Scheduling and delivering the requested training
not_included: Vendor-specific certification courses -- mention this if that's what you need and we'll advise
needed: The topic or system for training

name: Request for Proposal (RFP) Support
summary: Get IT's help preparing the technical portions of a Request for Proposal (RFP).
description: A Request for Proposal (RFP) is a formal document used to solicit bids from outside vendors. Use this if you're preparing an RFP and need IT's input on technical requirements or evaluation.
included: Reviewing and contributing to technical requirements
Help evaluating vendor responses
not_included: Writing the entire RFP -- IT supports the technical sections, not the whole document

name: Change Request (standard IT change)
summary: Submit a standard, planned change to an IT system or service.
description: Use this to formally request a planned change to an existing IT system or service, so it can be reviewed and scheduled properly rather than made informally.
included: Review and scheduling of the requested change
Communication of the change to affected users, if needed
not_included: Emergency, unplanned changes needed right away -- use "Report an Outage or Service Problem" or contact IT directly for anything urgent

name: Report an Outage or Service Problem
summary: Report a system outage or something that isn't working.
description: Use this to report that a system, service, or piece of equipment is down or not working correctly. The target time below is for an initial response, not full resolution -- how long a fix takes depends on the problem.
included: An initial response and assessment
Status updates as the issue is worked
not_included: Requests for something new -- use the matching "New ..." request instead
needed: What system or service is affected

questions.label: What system or service is affected?

name: Body-Worn Camera Request
summary: Request a body-worn camera and its setup for field use.
description: Use this to request a body-worn camera be issued and configured for an employee who works in the field. This includes device setup and enrollment in the video management system used to store recordings.
included: A body-worn camera device
Enrollment in the video storage system
Basic use training
not_included: In-vehicle cameras -- use "In-Car Camera Request" instead

name: In-Car Camera Request
summary: Request an in-vehicle camera system be installed and configured.
description: Use this to request that an in-car camera system be installed in a vehicle used for field work, including connecting it to the video storage system used to store recordings.
included: Installation of the in-car camera system
Enrollment in the video storage system
not_included: Body-worn cameras -- use "Body-Worn Camera Request" instead

name: Mobile Data Terminal Setup
summary: Set up a mobile data terminal in a field vehicle.
description: A mobile data terminal is a ruggedized computer mounted in a vehicle for field use. Use this to request one be installed and configured in a vehicle.
included: Installation and configuration of the mobile data terminal
Connecting it to required systems
not_included: Standard laptops or desktops -- use "New Computer Request" instead
needed: Systems it needs to connect to

questions.label: Systems it needs to connect to (optional)
